title: Jazz Night @ Hold Fast Brewing
event_description: Experience live jazz performances from local musicians. Features rotating jazz ensembles including The Brueggemann Gouge Jazz Band and MOJO Lite.
event_venue_information:
Live Jazz at Hold Fast Brewing

Hold Fast Brewing is an all-female-owned microbrewery located in a historic downtown fire station. The brewery has become renowned for hosting exceptional jazz performances every Tuesday evening from 7-9 PM with no cover charge. The atmosphere combines craft beer expertise with community spirit.

Jazz Programming

The venue features rotating jazz lineups including the Brueggemann Gouge Jazz Band featuring Ladies of Jazz (1st, 3rd and sometimes 5th Tuesdays) and MOJO Lite, a seven-piece ensemble born from the Missouri Jazz Orchestra, performing on 2nd and 4th Tuesdays. Each performance is unique with different vocalists and improvisational arrangements.

Venue Amenities

The brewery offers an extensive selection of hand-crafted craft beers, non-alcoholic options, and rotating food trucks. The space features both indoor and outdoor seating with a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere. Tips for musicians are encouraged but no cover is charged for performances.

title: Open Mic & Jam @ Where House Bar
event_description: Weekly open mic and jam session for musicians of all skill levels. Performers can showcase original music or covers in a supportive environment.
venue_address: 2463 W Sunshine Street Suite 120, Springfield, MO 65807
event_venue_information:
Where House Bar - The Jam House

Where House Bar transforms into The Jam House every Tuesday evening, providing a dedicated space for live music performance and audience engagement. The venue is located within the Metro Eats Farmers Market and Food Truck Park, offering a vibrant community atmosphere.

Open Mic and Jam Sessions

Every Tuesday from 6:30-9:30 PM the bar hosts open mic and jam sessions designed for musicians at any level. The supportive environment encourages both original compositions and cover performances. Sign-ups begin at 6:30 PM with hosting support provided by the venue.

Venue Features

The bar features a spacious interior with industrial-rustic design by the award-winning Mossinghoff Collective. Large overhead garage doors open during mild weather for a relaxed outdoor feel. The venue offers craft cocktails, local draft beers, wines, and access to food truck dining. Live music and entertainment happen regularly throughout the week.

title: Live Music Fridays & Saturdays @ Tie & Timber Beer Co.
event_description: Local and regional bands perform live music in the spacious beer garden. Multiple genres including folk, rock, and acoustic performances.
event_venue_information:
Tie & Timber Beer Co. - Live Music Venue

Tie & Timber Beer Co. hosts live music every Friday and Saturday starting at 7:30 PM. Located in the historic Pickwick Place business district in a building that was originally a lumberyard dating back to 1918, the brewery has become a community gathering place.

Music Programming

The brewery regularly features local and regional musicians performing a diverse range of genres from folk and acoustic to rock and tributes. Past performances have included artists ranging from folk singers to cover bands celebrating classic artists like Prince.

Venue Experience

Eighteen craft beers rotate on tap along with hand-crafted cocktails. The spacious outdoor patio and beer garden provide the perfect setting for enjoying live performances. The venue is pet-friendly and family-friendly with casual outdoor seating. No food menu but guests can bring their own or order from delivery services.

title: Hump Day Music @ Tie & Timber Beer Co.
event_description: Wednesday evening live music performances featuring local musicians in an intimate brewery setting.
event_venue_information:
Hump Day Music Tradition

Tie & Timber Beer Co. hosts Hump Day Music on Wednesday evenings, creating a mid-week opportunity to experience live music in a relaxed brewery atmosphere. The intimate setting celebrates local talent from the Springfield music scene.

title: First Friday & Live Music @ Mother's Brewing Company
event_description: Monthly First Friday celebrations featuring live music and art. Year-round festivals including Mother's Day Fest and Oktoberfest with live performances.
event_venue_information:
Mother's Brewing Company - Community Music Hub

Mother's Brewing Company hosts regular live music events throughout the year. The brewery is located in a historic downtown building that was formerly a Butternut bread bakery. With an expansive beer garden, outdoor playground, and spacious indoor tasting room, it serves as a major community gathering place.

Regular Events

First Friday events feature live music and local artists throughout the month. The brewery also hosts monthly movie nights and two major festivals annually: Mother's Day Fest (Saturday following Mother's Day) and Oktoberfest (second Saturday in September). These festivals feature food trucks, local vendors, and live music performances.

Venue Amenities

The brewery offers craft beer flights, diverse beer selection including unique styles, hard seltzers and ciders. The expansive outdoor area includes games, playground for families, and consistent live music programming. Pet-friendly and family-friendly environment with food trucks regularly on-site.
